subject.title: fix(plugins): bound hosted catalog feed reads on non-streaming responses

question: Should hosted catalog refresh fail closed to snapshot or bundled fallback when Fetch returns a streamless `Response.body`?
rationale: The code repair is focused, but it intentionally trades hosted feed availability for memory safety in non-streaming fetch environments, and that compatibility boundary needs maintainer ownership.

options.title: Accept fail-closed fallback
options.body: Land the PR once merge checks are clean, accepting snapshot or bundled fallback for streamless hosted feed responses.

options.title: Require bounded streamless support
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers choose a design that bounds streamless bodies without trusting headers or full buffering.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed fallback
recommendation.body: Land the PR once merge checks are clean, accepting snapshot or bundled fallback for streamless hosted feed responses.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the hosted feed loader and fallback contract being changed.
